text: [calm, natural narrator voice] The <|phoneme_start|>D R EH1 S D AY1 N<|phoneme_end|> bet: a sodium cylinder spinning while its axis slowly turns. Its knob: the precession ratio, how fast the axis turns relative to the spin.
